title: Leo's Birthday Breakfast
setting: A bright family kitchen on a winter morning.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

sentences.en: This Wednesday in December is Leo's birthday.
sentences.zh: 这个十二月的星期三是里奥的生日。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) wakes up smiling; snow falls outside his bedroom window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a happy winter morning; the day and month are not shown.
sentences.narration: Leo wakes up smiling. snow falls outside his bedroom window.

sentence_targets.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday
the final month of the year, following November

sentences.en: He is sixteen today and almost two metres tall.
sentences.zh: 他今天十六岁，个子将近两米。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) stands next to a door frame; his head almost touches the top.
sentences.draw_note: Shows how tall Leo is; his age and the exact height are not shown.
sentences.narration: Leo stands next to a door frame. his head almost touches the top.

sentence_targets.en: the number after fifteen and before seventeen
A unit of length equal to one hundred centimetres.

sentences.en: Every week, he cooks breakfast at seven a.m.
sentences.zh: 他每个星期都在早上七点做早饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) cooks eggs at the stove in the early morning light.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Leo cooking breakfast; 'every week' and the time are not shown.
sentences.narration: Leo cooks eggs at the stove in the early morning light.

sentence_targets.en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

sentences.en: His new cooking pot is very useful.
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) stirs porridge in a shiny new cooking pot.
sentences.narration: Leo stirs porridge in a shiny new cooking pot.

sentence_targets.en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun.
The activity of preparing food by heating it.
Helping you do something or achieve a purpose

sentences.en: He puts strawberries on the family table.
sentences.zh: 他把草莓放到家里的餐桌上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) puts a bowl of red strawberries on a long kitchen table set for the family.
sentences.narration: Leo puts a bowl of red strawberries on a long kitchen table set for the family.

sentence_targets.en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface
a group of people related to one another
a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs

sentences.en: Then poor Leo hits his head on the door.
sentences.zh: 接着，可怜的里奥一头撞在了门上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) rubs his head after bumping it on the top of a low door frame.
sentences.narration: Leo rubs his head after bumping it on the top of a low door frame.

sentence_targets.en: Having very little money or few possessions

sentences.en: His sister Mia, a kind girl, hugs him.
sentences.zh: 他的妹妹米娅是个善良的女孩，她抱了抱他。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) hugs Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) in the kitchen and laughs.
sentences.narration: Mia hugs Leo in the kitchen and laughs.

sentence_targets.en: A female child or young woman

sentences.en: Next year, he wants seventeen candles on his cake.
sentences.zh: 明年，他想要蛋糕上插十七根蜡烛。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) look at a birthday cake covered in lit candles.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a cake with many candles; 'next year' and the number are not shown.
sentences.narration: Leo and Mia look at a birthday cake covered in lit candles.

sentence_targets.en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.
